purpose: Independent source review of RP work arrangement and hiring geography; final organization classifications and their evidence are in the two shard files.

rethinking_priorities_geography.basis: The official organization-wide careers policy explicitly describes a fully remote staff and broad cross-border eligibility. It is relevant to the staff market, but is not a CEO vacancy or an executive-specific eligibility policy.

role_eligibility.rule: In most places, applicants with local work authorization will be considered.
role_eligibility.geographic_preference: American, European, and African time zones are typically preferred because most staff are in those regions.
role_eligibility.constraint: Applicants outside those time zones are welcomed, but employees are expected to attend some meetings during working hours in the preferred regions.
role_eligibility.interpretation: The policy is international and conditional, not worldwide eligibility without qualification. The time-zone language is a preference and meeting-time expectation, not a stated exclusion.

team_footprint.finding: The same official page says the fully remote staff is currently based in 15 countries.
team_footprint.interpretation: This directly supports an internationally distributed team and remote work model. It corroborates broad geographic operations; it does not by itself establish legal hiring eligibility in every country.

sources.quote: Although we are incorporated in the US, our fully remote staff is currently based in 15 countries.
In most places, if you have local work authorization, we will consider your application.
We typically prefer candidates located in American, European, or African time zones.
While we welcome candidates from outside of these time zones, we often have meetings during working hours in these time zones that employees are expected to attend.
supports: outside-region applicants are not categorically excluded

rethinking_priorities_geography.historical_caveat: The preserved official capture repeats the current policy language, but its source capture date is not independently established in this review. It corroborates wording, not a dated historical policy.
rethinking_priorities_geography.benchmark_owner_confirmation: 2026-09-05: RP CEO is a fully remote position. General staff eligibility is a labeled proxy for CEO hiring market, not a verified executive-specific country list.
